title: [AAPS 2.8.1.1 and 2.8.2] Password necessary to export the configuration
symptom: After installing AAPS 2.8.2 over AAPS 2.8.1.1, the user is required to enter a master password to export configuration, even though they disabled the master password for configuration export. In previous versions (2.7), exporting unencrypted settings did not require a password.
cause: The old unencrypted export format is no longer supported; a password is now required for all exports.
fix: The user must provide a password to export configuration; there is no workaround to export without a password.
evidence_quote: it's not possible to export with old unencrypted format anymore. you have to provide password
